Sector Moisture Explorer

The plot's bounding box split into 5×5-pixel sectors (partial at the edges). Choose NDWI or NDMI, then click a sector to see its own moisture history against ERA5 temperature for the same months — the whole-plot average, on the right, is the default view.

Monthly imagery — last year

Data: Sentinel-2 L2A monthly median composites via Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem (openEO), clipped to the client plot; NDWI = (B08-B11)/(B08+B11) (broad NIR); NDMI = (B8A-B11)/(B8A+B11) (narrow NIR) - same family, highly correlated but not identical. Temperature: ERA5 reanalysis via Open-Meteo's archive API. "Dry frequency" is the % of valid months the selected index fell below the threshold dryness threshold; "dry magnitude" is how far below threshold it typically fell on those months. Generated from outputs/monthly_ndvi_ndwi_ndmi.nc and outputs/era5_temperature_monthly.csv — no live data connection.
